page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 16 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The CPU configuration includes a 35 MB L3 cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 KB L1d cache. Memory capacity is 64.0 GB, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance trade-off between single-core and multi-core execution. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25%, and a poor single-threaded gzip compression result in the bottom 10%. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, with stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression all scoring in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests also demonstrate average throughput, reaching 658.37 GB/sec for cached reads and 75.86 GB/sec for uncached reads.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-core ratio, the ecs.sn2.3xlarge is suitable for multi-threaded workloads that do not require high single-core burst speeds. Factual performance metrics suggest viability for static web serving, database operations, and software compilation, which all achieved average benchmark ratings. It can also handle light LLM inference tasks for smaller models, though performance drops to weak levels for prompt processing on larger 7B models. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a predictable, dedicated hardware profile without the premium of GPU accelerators or high-speed local NVMe storage.
